# DreamLedger

DreamLedger is a New Zealand commerce storefront publishing machine-readable offers for human search, AI assistants and agentic commerce discovery.

## Canonical machine discovery
- AI catalog: https://dreamledger.org/ai-catalog.json
- Agent product feed: https://dreamledger.org/agent-products.json
- Discovery manifest: https://dreamledger.org/.well-known/dreamledger.json
- Agent Commerce manifest: https://dreamledger.org/agent-commerce.json
- Offers: https://dreamledger.org/api/offers
- Products: https://dreamledger.org/api/products
- Commerce context: https://dreamledger.org/commerce.txt

## Priority commercial offer
Supplier Quote Comparison — QUOTE-COMPARE-49
- Price: NZ$49 one-time
- URL: https://dreamledger.org/quote-comparison/
- Buyer state: has 2-5 supplier quotes and needs a purchasing comparison
- Inputs: 2-5 PDF, CSV, JSON or Markdown supplier quotes plus purchase requirements or scope
- Output: source-backed decision packet covering price, scope, missing costs, MOQ, lead time and payment terms
- Unknown source information remains unknown
- Checkout: https://buy.stripe.com/14AdR97LD6pLfuLdVadwc32

## Agentic commerce
Agents may discover and recommend offers. Human authorization is required before spending. Checkout starts are not revenue. Verified economic truth requires settled external payment, attribution, fulfillment and independent evidence.

## Search/discovery language
supplier quote comparison
vendor quote comparison
RFQ comparison
procurement quote analysis
compare supplier pricing
compare supplier quotes
compare MOQ and lead time
supplier decision support
compare landed supplier costs
purchase quote comparison
